name: logseq-convert-md-to-lfm
description: Convert standard Markdown (especially pasted from ChatGPT or similar) into Logseq-Flavored Markdown: nest code blocks inside bullets, fix heading-to-indent levels, drop horizontal rules, convert wide tables to label-value bullets, fix footnotes to URL-only, and replace generic link text. Use when the user pastes non-LFM markdown to import, asks to "convert to LFM", or to clean up an AI-generated dump. For table column alignment use logseq-table-formatter; for baseline LFM rules see logseq-core / logseq-lfm.
